games.name: Lantern Memory
games.tagline: Watch the lanterns glow, then light them in the same order.

steps.short: Watch the lanterns. Light them in the same order.
steps: Lanterns glow one at a time.
Wait until they stop.
Select the lanterns in the same order.

games.name: Quiet Signals
games.tagline: Gather the golden blooms. Let the closed buds rest.

steps.short: Select golden flowers. Leave grey buds alone.
steps: A flower appears on the pond.
If it is golden, select it.
If it is a grey bud, wait. It will fade.

games.name: Sorting Stones
games.tagline: Sort river stones by the rule on the card. Rules change with a clear signal.

steps.short: Follow the card. Send each stone left or right.
steps: Read the rule card at the top.
Send each stone to the matching basket.
When the card changes, you will see a signal first.

games.name: Meadow Search
games.tagline: Find the one flower that is different from the others.

steps.short: Find the flower that is different. Select it.
steps: Look across the meadow.
One flower is different.
Select it.

games.name: Constellation Trace
games.tagline: Join the stars in order to draw the constellation.

steps.short: Select the stars in order, 1, 2, 3 and on.
steps: Find star number 1.
Then star number 2, and so on.
A thread of light joins them.

games.name: Echo Garden
games.tagline: Is this flower the same as the one before?

steps.short: Is it the same as before? Choose Same or Different.
steps: One flower shows at a time.
Compare it with the previous one.
Choose Same or Different.

games.name: Pattern Loom
games.tagline: Work out the rule and choose the tile that finishes the pattern.

steps.short: Find the rule. Choose the tile that fits the gap.
steps: Look at the row of tiles.
Find what changes each time.
Choose the tile that fits the gap.

games.name: Steady Beat
games.tagline: Select as the ring meets the circle. A slow, even rhythm.

steps.short: Select just as the ring reaches the circle.
steps: A ring slowly closes in.
When it meets the circle, select.
The rhythm stays the same.

games.name: Mirror Match
games.tagline: Which pattern is the mirror image?

steps.short: Find the mirror image of the pattern.
steps: Look at the pattern on the left.
Imagine it in a mirror.
Select the matching reflection.

games.name: Firefly Count
games.tagline: A few fireflies glow for a moment. How many were there?

steps.short: Fireflies glow briefly. Select how many you saw.
steps: Fireflies glow in the jar.
They fade after a moment.
Select the number you saw.

traits.label: Sensitive to bright or flashing light
